instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Build, without sending it, the payment provider (Stripe) request that starts a seller's payment setup and gets their hosted onboarding link, or any other request the folder's operation map names", and give it operation_id.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:build-a-sellers-payment-setup-request and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Calls buildStripeHttpRequest (process/build-provider-request.mjs) with the input: operation_id names one row of data/provider-operation-map.json (operation:create-connected-account and operation:create-account-link start a seller's setup and its hosted onboarding link; the map has every other operation too), input_facts holds what the request says (operation_subject becomes the form-encoded body of a write or the query of a search, provider_object_ref fills the address, acting_account the Stripe-Account header where the row declares it; a subject id becomes client_reference_id), idempotency_key becomes the Idempotency-Key header of a write, api_version_policy the Stripe-Version (the map's current version when left out) and required_credential_ref the name of the key a sender would use (credential-class:stripe-restricted-key when left out).
